points.name: Purana Quila Rd storm drain (India Gate→Yamuna)
points.geo_display_name: Purana Quila Road, Central Vista
points.incident_summary: India Gate→Yamuna storm-water corridor along Purana Quila Road. Delhi HC (8 Apr 2024) recorded PWD’s six-segment jurisdiction map across NDMC, PWD, MCD and Irrigation & Flood Control after 2023 monsoon flooding of the carriageway and High Court pool bungalows. Exclusive operational ownership remains unresolved.

claim_summaries.NDMC: HC record: India Gate–Priya Nursery–NSCI Club Gate segment under NDMC.
claim_summaries.PWD: HC record: Purana Quila Road (Priya Nursery) to petrol pump and Gate No. 5–open nallah under PWD.
claim_summaries.MCD: HC record: petrol pump–ITPO Gate No. 5 and open nallah–Ring Road control gate under MCD.
claim_summaries.IFC: HC record: Ring Road control gate to Yamuna outfall under Irrigation & Flood Control.

points.name: Bharat Mandapam / Purana Quila tunnel
points.geo_display_name: Bharat Mandapam, Bhairon Marg
points.incident_summary: Bharat Mandapam / Purana Quila tunnel — HC (Apr 2024) noted 2023 monsoon closure of the newly built tunnel maintained by L&T under PWD supervision. TOI (Jul 2024) links repeated flooding to ITPO underground parking seepage and incomplete Bharat Mandapam drainage.

claim_summaries.PWD: Court and press attribute tunnel maintenance supervision and corridor drainage works to PWD.

points.name: Mathura Rd / High Court pool bungalows
points.geo_display_name: Delhi High Court, Central Vista
points.incident_summary: Mathura Road / High Court pool bungalows — HC took judicial notice of 2023 carriageway and bungalow flooding alongside the Purana Quila drain dispute. TOI notes VIP Mathura Road as low-lying with ongoing stormwater redesign tied to the Pragati corridor.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD informed the court and leads Mathura Road desilt/redesign narratives in press.

points.name: Barapullah drain (outfall / wall breach)
points.geo_display_name: Barapullah Bridge
points.incident_summary: Barapullah basin — major south/central outfall to the Yamuna. IE (29 Jun 2024) reported wall breach and back-flow after extreme rain plus a PWD→MCD→I&FC transfer with lack of clarity. Later NGT/L-G coverage continued to flag unfinished dredging stretches.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD officials: drain not under PWD after transfer; cite back-flow impacts citywide.
claim_summaries.MCD: MCD officials: handed the drain to Irrigation & Flood Control.
claim_summaries.IFC: I&FC: takeover incomplete; NGT later flagged stretches with no stated desilt owner.

points.name: Minto Bridge / Minto Road underpass
points.geo_display_name: Shivaji Bridge (Minto alias)
points.incident_summary: Minto Road underpass near Connaught Place — perennial monsoon hotspot. Jun 2024 press documents NDMC/MCD border blame, PWD road/pump interventions, and railways under-bridge neglect narratives after the underpass flooded again following hotspot delisting periods.

claim_summaries.NDMC: Press: NDMC says outflow drains into MCD drains that were not cleaned.
claim_summaries.MCD: MLA/press: bridge sits on NDMC–MCD border; agencies blame each other.
claim_summaries.PWD: Press: road ownership and pump-house capacity upgrades attributed to PWD.
claim_summaries.RAILWAYS: Press: some PWD officials said the area under the bridge falls to railways.

points.name: AIIMS / Aurobindo Marg
points.geo_display_name: A.I.I.M.S., Aurobindo Marg
points.incident_summary: AIIMS / Aurobindo Marg — Newslaundry (29 Jun 2024): nearly five-feet inundation; PWD maintains Aurobindo Marg to Gautam Nagar turn while drains near AAI/Rajiv Bhavan fall under NDMC, which blamed blocked MCD downstream drains. NDMC later listed AIIMS underbridges among vulnerable CCTV-monitored points.

claim_summaries.PWD: Road maintenance on Aurobindo Marg to Gautam Nagar turn attributed to PWD.
claim_summaries.NDMC: Drains near AAI office under NDMC; NDMC lists AIIMS underbridges as vulnerable.
claim_summaries.MCD: NDMC stated waterlogging followed from uncleared MCD drains receiving NDMC outflow.

points.name: Lodhi Rd / Moolchand Ring Rd
points.geo_display_name: Moolchand Flyover
points.incident_summary: Lodhi Road / Moolchand Ring Road — low-lying arterial and VIP-quarter approaches. Newslaundry (29 Jun 2024): CPWD quarters, PWD main road, MCD bylanes. Kushak/Barapullah back-flow context recurs in NDMC/PWD pump disputes.

claim_summaries.PWD: Main road and Moolchand underpass hotspot monitoring attributed to PWD.
claim_summaries.CPWD: Government quarters on Lodhi Road maintained by CPWD per press.
claim_summaries.MCD: Bylanes under MCD; representatives also point to city drainage responsibility.

points.name: Maharani Bagh / Taimur Nagar drain / Ring Rd wells
points.geo_display_name: Maharani Bagh
points.incident_summary: Maharani Bagh / Taimur Nagar drain / Ring Road wells — HT (28 Jun 2024) documented sewage-mixed flooding of homes after Taimoor Nagar drain outfall clogging; RWA had warned for months. Fixture evidence also ties PWD/MCD/DJB claim edges on wells and drains.

claim_summaries.PWD: Arterial / Ring Road well and drain interventions appear in PWD complaint clusters.
claim_summaries.MCD: MCD desilting claims and colony drain maintenance disputed by residents/RWA.
claim_summaries.DJB: Sewer overflow mixing with stormwater raises DJB network questions in press coverage.

points.name: Ring Road opposite WHO (ITO)
points.geo_display_name: Indraprastha Estate
points.incident_summary: Ring Road opposite WHO (ITO) — perennial hotspot. IE (29 Jun 2024): a drain connecting Central Delhi, ITO and the WHO building overflowed for hours, delaying clearance at ITO and Minto. TOI (Aug 2024) again named ITO among usual suspects with insufficient pumps.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD control-room and hotspot lists treat the WHO/ITO Ring Road stretch as a critical PWD location.

points.name: Zakhira flyover underpass
points.geo_display_name: Zakhira Flyover
points.incident_summary: Zakhira flyover underpass — chronic monsoon hotspot. TOI (Aug 2024): railway-adjacent waste/inflow clogs pumps; PWD minister wrote to Railways that a shared-cost culvert on railway land remains unbuilt after PWD deposited its share (Jul 2023).

claim_summaries.PWD: Road-owning agency for the underpass; installed screens and pursues railway culvert works.

points.name: Pul Prahladpur underpass
points.geo_display_name: Police Station Pul Prahladpur
points.incident_summary: Pul Prahladpur underpass — critical PWD hotspot. TOI (Aug 2024): despite a 2022 underground sump (7.5 lakh litres) and 600 HP permanent pump house, the underpass still flooded when pumps were overwhelmed; named again in citywide underpass inundation lists.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD constructed sump/pump house and lists the underpass among critical monsoon points.

points.name: Azad Market underpass
points.geo_display_name: Azad Market
points.incident_summary: Azad Market underpass — central Delhi depressed section. HT (Jun 2024): severe inundation with passengers trapped in a submerged bus; traffic alerts closed or diverted the stretch. Exclusive agency owner is unclear in sources (fixture uses OTHER).

claim_summaries.OTHER: Press documents severe underpass inundation without a clean exclusive agency assignment.

points.geo_display_name: Bhairon Marg
points.incident_summary: Pragati Maidan / Bhairon corridor tunnel — repeatedly closed in monsoon. TOI (Jul 2024): PWD building a supplementary drain on Purana Quila Road; cites rainwater from Bhairon Marg VIP low-lying stretch and incomplete Bharat Mandapam/ITPO parking drainage entering the tunnel.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD manages the transit corridor and is constructing supplementary drainage works.

points.name: Loni Rd roundabout
points.geo_display_name: Loni Road
points.incident_summary: Loni Road roundabout — converging point from Loni Road and Wazirabad/Signature Bridge approaches. TOI (Aug 2024): PWD plans drain remodel, pump house and sump well as a long-term waterlogging intervention at this hotspot.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD road-owning agency with published remodel / pump-house plans for the roundabout.

points.incident_summary: Azadpur underpass — northwest depressed section among worst-hit in Jun 2024. HT: PWD deployed multiple pumps while sewer backflow raised water levels; underpass closed after vehicles broke down. Multi-agency edges (PWD/MCD) appear in fixture claims.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD pump houses and clearance operations cited in press for Azadpur underpass.
claim_summaries.MCD: Local drain/colony interfaces and MCD complaint channels appear in wider monsoon coverage.

claim_summaries.PWD: Underpass appears on PWD flood-control / hotspot monitoring lists.
claim_summaries.MCD: PWD officials told TOI Siraspur underpass jurisdiction is MCD.

claim_summaries.DDA: TOI: Okhla underpass falls under DDA control; DDA has contested some attributions.
claim_summaries.PWD: PWD flood-control / underpass SOP narratives cover citywide depressed sections.

claim_summaries.PWD: PWD engineers cite bowl geometry; minister ordered drainage and pumping upgrades.

claim_summaries.PWD: Appears on PWD-linked underpass inundation and traffic-advisory lists.

claim_summaries.PWD: Ring Road / hub approaches appear in PWD complaint and flooding narratives.

claim_summaries.PWD: Airport-route arterial waterlogging responses attributed to PWD in monsoon coverage.
